## Settings.contentWidth property

Available width at the root of the render tree, prior to scrolling.

**Signature:**

```typescript
contentWidth: number;
```

## Remarks

This is the width offered to the document as a whole. The horizontal spacing of the table's ancestors, and of the table itself, is subtracted from it by the table layout engine.
